recording_fake_git_gh:
#!/bin/bash
name=${0##*/}
printf '%s\0' "$PWD" "${GH_REPO:-}" "$name" "$@" > "$ORACLE_RECORDS/$$-$RANDOM"
if [[ $name == git ]]; then
  original=("$@")
  while [[ $1 == -C* ]]; do
    if [[ $1 == -C ]]; then cd "$2" || exit; shift 2; else cd "${1:2}" || exit; shift; fi
  done
  if [[ $ORACLE_GIT_DELEGATE == 1 ]]; then
    case "$1" in checkout|switch|branch) :;; *) exec /usr/bin/git "${original[@]}";; esac
  fi
  if [[ $1 == rev-parse ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$PWD"; exit; fi
elif [[ $name == gh ]]; then
  if [[ $1 == alias && $2 == set ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$4" > "$ORACLE_ALIAS"; exit; fi
  if [[ $1 == mm && -f $ORACLE_ALIAS ]]; then
    read -r -a alias_words < "$ORACLE_ALIAS"; shift; exec gh "${alias_words[@]}" "$@"
  fi
fi
limits: No network targets. ssh uses -G (configuration only); docker uses --help. Git fetch/push use a nonexistent local remote, not a network URL. Failure to execute is descriptive and never proves unreachability.
executor_setup: Python payloads resolve python to a local Bash launcher of the task-prescribed project interpreter. tmux uses a private socket, waits for a recorded signal, then kills only that server. ORACLE_GIT_DELEGATE follows each row git_delegate field.
executor_option_preconditions: bisect run: add a third changed commit and start with HEAD bad/HEAD~2 good. difftool: dirty file. push: fixture remote is a local empty bare repository and branch.main.remote/merge bind main to fixture/main. submodule foreach: create a local empty-commit seed repository and add it as sub using protocol.file.allow=always. difftool.prompt=false removes interactive waiting. Clear setup records before the submitted command. systemd-run inherits only the caller bus transport variables if present; never publish their values.
git_internal_preconditions: Second commit changes file; create a helper directory symlinking the installed Git exec-path helpers except git, which symlinks the recording fake; set GIT_EXEC_PATH to it. Read scratch .git/HEAD after execution for builtin alias expansion, even if a redirect corrupts .git/config.
normalization: Replace the per-row temp root with <probe>; store no host addresses, identities or stderr paths.
round2_probe_preconditions: Per command isolated directories wt/link/a/b and files; recording git/gh only. taskset permits CPUs 0-8191, chrt selects SCHED_OTHER, prlimit lowers only the probe soft/hard fd limit. watch -x is bounded by timeout 0.4. command -p uses system default PATH (not recording PATH); absence of a recorder is a limitation, never proof of safety. No network/mutation-capable real gh/git may execute: command -p probes run only with recorder paths as documented in round2_resolution.
round2_resolution: command -p probes use ORACLE_GIT/ORACLE_GH to select an absolute recording executable, preserving -p behavior without invoking host git/gh. These dynamic command names require refusal under amendment 6. exec -a records actual argv.

elif [[ $name == gh ]]; then
